card.name: The word co before administration
card.fires_on: The piece "co" starting "co-administration" (or "coadministration") of NSAIDs, right after a list of risk conditions such as elderly, volume-depleted or compromised renal function.

modes.label: Co-administration of NSAIDs
modes.description: The prefix "co" opens "co-administration" after a clause about elderly or renal-impaired patients in NSAID interaction warnings.
modes.example: In patients who are elderly, volume-depleted (including those on diuretic therapy), or with compromised renal function,<< co>>-administration of NSAIDs, including selective

card.plain: It fires on the "co" that begins "co-administration" in NSAID warnings about elderly or kidney-impaired patients.
